title: Kapital Boro Indigo Canvas Tote Bag
description_en: Kapital's boro-inspired tote is a wearable piece of Japanese textile art — patched with vintage indigo fabric scraps using the traditional Japanese art of boro (repairing with patches). Each bag is one of a kind. Not available outside Japan.
description_ja: ヴィンテージのインディゴ布を「ボロ」の技法でパッチワークしたキャピタルのトートバッグ。一点一点が異なる表情を持つ、纏うアート。日本国外では入手困難なコレクターズアイテム。
